'''Xandyk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], Xandyk was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A noted [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi instructor|instructor]], Xandyk was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as part of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] presence while the majority of the Order relocated to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] following the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Master Xandyk frequented the Senate Commerce Hall in the heart of the [[Senate Commercial District]] under the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]].<ref name="TOR" />
